title: sideritis arborescens var. maura
intro: Sideritis arborescens var. maura, commonly known as Greek mountain tea, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of Greece and Turkey. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions attributed to Greek mountain tea include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
